breaking_news.headline: Journalists for CNN, MS NOW and Politico return to the White House upon judge's orders
breaking_news.summary: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

breaking_news.headline: eBay bans airbag sales as concerns about faulty or counterfeit parts rise
breaking_news.summary: eBay became the latest online retailer to ban the sale of airbags and many of their components. Aftermarket parts can be risky if they turn out to be fake or defective.

breaking_news.headline: The economic squeeze is pushing up poverty rates for older adults
breaking_news.summary: Despite lower poverty overall, the rate for seniors has been steadily rising in recent years. A new AARP survey sheds light on how those over 50 are struggling in the crucial time before retirement.

breaking_news.headline: Mortgage rates have just surpassed 7% for the first time in well over a year
breaking_news.summary: Rates have climbed more than a full percentage point since the U.S. war against Iran started.

breaking_news.headline: How stores choose what to put on their shelves — like, say, Planet Money's board game
breaking_news.summary: The most coveted real estate in business might just be the choicest shelf space of national big box retail. We go inside the room and the process of how stores choose what you can and can't buy.

breaking_news.headline: American farmers are hurting -- and worried about their futures
breaking_news.summary: Farmers who grow soybeans, corn, cotton and other crops are facing another year of losses as soaring fuel and fertilizer costs offset higher revenues.

breaking_news.headline: The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve is low. Here's why you should care
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. has tapped into its strategic oil reserve to help drive down rising gasoline prices in the wake of the war with Iran. Can oil from Venezuela help fill it back up?

breaking_news.headline: Why this Pokémon set is dropping in value
breaking_news.summary: How does one price a cemetery plot? Are they using dynamic pricing to figure it out? We tackle that question and many more in this week's Indicator newsletter.

breaking_news.headline: Jay-Z rape accuser says her allegation was false
breaking_news.summary: A woman who accused Jay-Z of raping her when she was 13 now says she has never met the rap superstar.

breaking_news.headline: Senior Kazakh officials detained after 14 service members swept out to sea
breaking_news.summary: Seventeen service members were swept out to the Caspian Sea during military exercises.

breaking_news.headline: Man shot during 2024 Trump campaign rally in Butler dies
breaking_news.summary: A gunman shot Jim Copenhaver twice while also killing another man and grazing Trump's ear with a bullet.

breaking_news.headline: Students strike across Germany in protest against military service
breaking_news.summary: A law establishing voluntary military service came into effect in January, but protest organisers fear compulsory service could follow.

breaking_news.headline: Supreme Court allows Trump to use controversial database to check voter citizenship
breaking_news.summary: Critics have questioned the reliability of the data, warning it could  result in US citizens being wrongly removed from electoral rolls.

breaking_news.headline: Xi got Trump's red carpet welcome - but not everything he wanted
breaking_news.summary: China wanted progress on trade, technology and Taiwan - but hasn't got as much as it would have hoped for.

breaking_news.headline: Pope warns against 'losing humanity' to AI machines
breaking_news.summary: The pontiff delivered the warning on the first day of his trip to France on Friday.

breaking_news.headline: Trump and Xi exchange warm words at state dinner but little progress on key issues
breaking_news.summary: Despite diplomatic niceties and gifts, little was shared on substantial issues separating the leaders.

breaking_news.headline: Farmers down 240 million litres of milk after heat
breaking_news.summary: Milk yield was affected by a series of extreme heatwaves which led to poor grazing conditions, researchers say.

breaking_news.headline: X-planes: Are they needed in the new era of drones?
breaking_news.summary: Where do America's X-plane projects fit in an era of cheap drones?

breaking_news.headline: 'We're all broke': Would you chase a friend for £5?
breaking_news.summary: What's the smallest amount of money you would ask a friend to pay you back?

breaking_news.headline: Special agents' blood and urine test results stolen in FBI hack
breaking_news.summary: Experts say the hack could leave agents vulnerable to scams, blackmail and targeted attacks.
